patient_utility.answer: Therapeutic agents remain in CSF longer, improving treatment efficacy while CSF continues to drain. Reduces repeat dosing burden for chronic conditions (tumor, meningitis, neurodegenerative).
patient_utility.evidence_required: Clinical trial showing therapeutic half-life extension + symptom improvement
patient_utility.current_evidence: MODEL_DERIVED — V72 moat map analysis (32% half-life reduction model); not validated clinically

therapeutic_utility.description: What therapeutic capability does the platform gain?
therapeutic_utility.answer: Selective molecular retention enables localized chemotherapy, antibiotic therapy, and biologic delivery without systemic exposure. Any therapeutic above MWCO (30 kDa) is retained.
therapeutic_utility.evidence_required: In vivo study showing therapeutic retention in CSF while drainage maintained
therapeutic_utility.current_evidence: MODEL_SUPPORTED — membrane physics supports retention; no in vivo proof

product_utility.description: What product could CereVasc actually sell?
product_utility.answer: eShunt with retention module — a product line extension of the existing eShunt platform. Incremental SKU, not a new product category.
product_utility.evidence_required: Market analysis showing demand for therapeutic-retention shunt
product_utility.current_evidence: MODEL_SUPPORTED — assumes CereVasc's existing eShunt manufacturing and regulatory infrastructure

platform_utility.description: Can the architecture support multiple therapeutics?
platform_utility.answer: YES — size-selective membrane is therapeutic-agnostic. Albumin (66 kDa), IgG (150 kDa), bevacizumab (149 kDa) all retained. Small molecules pass through.
platform_utility.evidence_required: In vitro testing with multiple therapeutics showing retention + CSF passage
platform_utility.current_evidence: MODEL_SUPPORTED — membrane physics supports multiple therapeutics
